Installs over 0.1.6 and keeps your saved designs. If you still have 0.1.5 or earlier, uninstall it first (share any project specification you want to keep, because uninstalling deletes saved projects).

**Full-size AR starts on more phones**

- View in room now always tries full-size AR. It no longer gives up when Google Play Services for AR is slow to answer, missing or out of date; the app prompts to install or update it instead.
- If AR still does not start, an on-screen panel shows the reason, an **Install or update Google Play Services for AR** button and **Try again**.
- Phones that Google reports cannot run AR see a clear message and a link to the supported phone list, then the camera and photo view.
- The printed floor marker camera has been removed.
